# contract gold smoke fixture

A real labeling run on 2 public document(s) of type `contract` (DOC-0c5144a5b68c5ee4, DOC-0efbd6c505e1d339; dataset `Lucius-Morningstar/mailroom-dataset` at `ccd040f6a1b6`), task `cuad` / set `pending`, with z-ai/glm-5.3-flashx-legal, deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash: the documents as downloaded (`documents.jsonl`), every model call (`calls.jsonl`) and the review packet the run produced (`expected-review-data.json`). Recorded 2026-11-08T06:47:40Z by LM at commit `b86e7956b8d6` for $0.0069 (5 answered, 0 failed calls). Tests replay it offline; it goes stale when a prompt, model, reasoning level, the dataset revision or a document changes: `PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m mailroom_eda.labeling.smoke_fixtures check` says what changed, and `PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m mailroom_eda.labeling.smoke_fixtures record --types contract --initials XX --cap-usd 0.40 --replace` re-records it (paid; see `docs/labeler-review-viewer.md`, "Gold smoke fixtures").
